Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIRCOT Business Manager Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Business Manager post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Business Manager post at ICAR CIRCOT is scheduled for 09 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Business Manager position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a M.Tech/MBA/CA/PGDM/Equivalent master degree in specific fields like Agriculture, Agri Business, Commerce, Marketing, Economics, or International Business, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Business Manager post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Business Manager post is between 25 years and 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and PH candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Business Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Business Manager position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1.25 Lakh Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates), and a category certificate if applicable. A filled application form might also be required.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR CIRCOT Business Manager recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICAR CIRCOT office in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400019.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Business Manager position is a contractual role at ICAR CIRCOT.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Business Manager post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, which may be conducted in a Hybrid Mode.
